_comment: Quarterly goals — the ONLY thing updated by hand each quarter. Keys are the rr1 metric keys and MUST match the engine's quarter label exactly (e.g. 'Q4 2026', 'Q1 2027'). 'in_progress' is the weekly install target (Revenue Installed goal / 13 weeks). Update these 7 numbers at the start of each quarter. NOTE: 'Q1 2027' holds PLACEHOLDER numbers (copied from Q4 2026) so the board never freezes at the year rollover — replace all 7 with the real 2027 Q1 goals when they're set.
